description: Load vet pack — authority + BASICs + broker + OFAC name. Pre-tender check: FMCSA authority and SMS BASICs (monthly) for the carrier, broker authority for broker_mc, optional OFAC name screen. TENDER/HOLD/REJECT from public fields only, no fraud score. A section that times out returns status "timeout" with partial:true and a HOLD verdict; full price applies when carrier authority (broker, for a broker-only pack) is delivered. $0.25 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.

broker_mc.description: broker MC/docket number — runs the FMCSA broker-authority check (optional)

dot.description: carrier USDOT number (optional; give dot, mc or broker_mc)

mc.description: carrier MC/docket number (optional; give dot, mc or broker_mc)
